summary: The Interstate Planning Committee met on May 22, 1974, concurred with NIPC's position, found no unresolved conflict between NE Illinois and NW Indiana jurisdictions, and voted unanimously to endorse the application without additional comments.
text:
At a meeting held May 22, 1974, the Interstate Planning Committee concurred with the position taken by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission.
The attached letter should, therefore, be included as part of your final application to the appropriate federal or state agency, along with all other comments received through the Metropolitan Clearinghouse review.
If you have any questions in regard to this matter, please contact Mr. John Swanson, our Project Review Coordinator.
Wery truly yours. William S. Luhman foo

DATE OF IPC ACTION:
May 22nd, 1974
The Interstate Planning Committee concurred with the position taken by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission on this application. The Committee was satisfied that there was no unresolved conflict between the two jurisdictions, N.E. Illinois and N.W. Indiana, and voted unanimously to endorse the application without additional comments.
